name: Wardrobe
description: Save your worn outfits and switch between them instantly by hotkey or menu, with a live 3D preview.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Switch outfits in the world — the game confirms the change with its own banner.
The Wardrobe window — saved outfits with a live 3D preview of the hovered one.

added: Each saved outfit now remembers the weapon skin your class was using and re-applies it when you switch.
The 3D preview shows the saved weapon skin when it belongs to your current class.
fixed: You can now scroll through every saved outfit — the list used to stop at the 48th.
Outfits with two head accessories preview both pieces at once (needs framework 2.6.0).
Saving an outfit no longer freezes the game for a moment (needs framework 2.6.0).
changed: Your outfits are now stored in the plugin's own data folder; existing outfits are carried over automatically on first launch.
